In detail

Sorgane is a 1970s public-housing high-rise district on the southeastern edge of the city. Local press has reported genuine drug-trafficking arrests here (including a 19-year-old arrested with over 900 grams of hashish on a stolen scooter, and a 30-year-old arrested for dealing) and one incident where a woman was threatened with a blade by a group of youths in a dispute over a barking dog. These are real but isolated documented incidents rather than a pattern of widespread violent crime. Sources checked: FirenzeToday, hashish/scooter arrest in Sorgane; FirenzeToday, drug-dealing arrest in Sorgane; La Nazione, woman threatened with blade by youths in Sorgane.
